title: BlueBlocks: P2P Discovery Service
description:
Implement HTTPS-based discovery service for P2P network peer registration and routing.

## API Endpoints
POST /api/v1/peers/register - Register peer with network
POST /api/v1/peers/{id}/heartbeat - Send keepalive
GET  /api/v1/peers - Discover peers by capability/region
GET  /api/v1/peers/{id} - Get peer details
DELETE /api/v1/peers/{id} - Unregister peer
POST /api/v1/routes/request - Request relay route to destination
GET  /health - Health check

## Features
- Session-based authentication with Ed25519 signatures
- Peer capability filtering (patient, provider, relay, gateway)
- Geographic region filtering
- Reputation tracking
- Automatic stale peer cleanup
- Relay route computation
